method: Sequential API analyses in a persistent process; ZIP loading excluded; installed KB/feeds enabled. Hourly/minute figures are scaled estimates from batch elapsed time, not hour-long runs. No parallelism. CPU/OS/file caches are not flushed. Public HTTP/browser comparison limits traversal to one fetched page. Default traversal diagnostic is excluded from successful-capacity figures.

quality-offline-public.fixture: Synthetic ordinary Russian mail, one link to public example.com; real HTTPS; no malicious targets

quality-replay-real.fixture: Recorded pages only; transport substituted, real internet latency excluded

quality-browser-dynamic.fixture: Controlled email then password form; real Edge/OCR/probing; transport substituted; no request with canary transmitted
